prompt_en: A cinematic dark-fantasy fashion photograph of an unmistakably adult Korean woman, using the attached portrait as her facial and hair reference, transformed into a fallen-angel maid. In a shadowed Gothic manor, she leans beside a tarnished silver tea cart, and she sets down a black porcelain cup with one lace-gloved hand while meeting the camera with calm confidence. Her fitted black satin maid dress features an opaque sculpted corset bodice, delicate ivory lace, a short layered skirt, thigh-high stockings, garter-inspired straps, and a small lace headpiece; the styling is sensual and elegant. Large charcoal feathered wings, a cracked dark halo, and drifting feathers make the fallen-angel identity unmistakable. Preserve her long glossy wavy black hair, warm brown almond-shaped eyes, soft oval face, natural skin texture, and adult facial proportions. Her full figure remains visually dominant while the Gothic room and tea cart establish the narrative space. A broad window-shaped shaft of cool moonlight crosses low candlelight and crimson reflections, sculpting her face, wings, and satin. Full-body vertical composition, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, realistic feather and fabric detail.
